g.text: State feature, bugfix, release, incident, or audit intent
Load adw-core and the stage-specific skill
Inspect repository, adapter, manifest, issue/PR, and live state
Create or update plan, branch, issue, acceptance criteria, and rollback considerations
Approve the implementation path when required
Explicitly approve the exact PR source branch, target branch, and replacement/deletion effect
Create or update the linked PR only for the approved exact route
PR links issue, plan, diff, validation evidence, and deployment notes
Plan/apply preview configuration through canonical tasks
Deploy and inspect canonical status evidence
Run supported health, readiness, E2E, and deployment validation
State whether deployment is requested and approve its exact target if so
Resolve opaque environment from manifest and adapter
Verify status, identity, health, readiness, E2E, and business semantics as supported
Use adapter-declared restore strategy and canonical deployment gates
Update issue/PR and report revision, evidence, target, risks, and next action
